label: Noir Night Scene
description: Film noir with the style pillars locked in prose: pushed black-and-white stock, one hard light, the night city. Randomness lives in who stands in the beam and where.
prefix: A film-noir scene on pushed black-and-white stock — {figure} holding still in the night city, light and shadow doing all the storytelling.
suffix: Noir Rendering: (pushed 3200-speed black-and-white film, coarse grain clumping in the shadows, blacks crushed to velvet:1.25), halation swelling around every naked bulb, venetian-blind shadows raking across the scene, wet asphalt doubling the lights, cigarette haze hanging in the beam, fatal glamour restraint.
negative: color photograph, colorized, cheerful daylight, watermark, text, child, underage
